answer: Make every agent re-solve a memory-hard puzzle each epoch to keep its seat, a cipher keyed to that epoch's seed so the work can't be precomputed. If one solve burns about $0.02 of RAM-bound compute while per-seat rewards are capped at $0.015, a farm of 10,000 cloned agents named juniper-1 to juniper-10000 loses $50 every epoch. Reaching the summit of the reward table is cheaper by honest work than by forking identities.
